distribution: Menglun, Mengla, Yunnan, 600 m above sea level.
soldier: Head deep yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal part nearly the same colour as the head, labrum darker than the head, antennae pale yellow tinged with smoky, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow, legs milk-white. Head with scattered long hairs; labrum with a pair of apical hairs and, from the tip of the labrum to the middle, three to four pairs of hairs in longitudinal rows on each side; the margin of the pronotum with long and short hairs alternating. Head nearly obovate, widest from behind the antennal carinae to before the middle of the head, the posterior margin slightly arcuate outwards; labrum tongue-shaped, its front bluntly rounded. Mandibles rather thick and straight, their front curved inwards, each with a marginal tooth-granule towards the front of the middle, and a denticle at the side of the basal tooth, the right denticle larger than the left. Postmentum raised, rounded spoon-shaped. Antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest. The anterior half of the pronotum upturned, slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight. Small soldier: head pale yellow, labrum yellow, mandibles reddish brown with the basal part the same colour as the head; antennae, pronotum, abdomen and legs all paler than in the large soldier; the shape of the head, the mandibles and the features of the pronotum similar to those of the large soldier.
